summary.key_theme: Amazon 在雲端運算與 AI 領域的強勁擴張與投資動能，與面臨的反壟斷監管及勞工權益挑戰形成多空拉鋸。

bullish.title: AWS Plans 2 Million More NVIDIA GPUs. Is This Better News for AMZN’s Cloud Growth or NVDA’s Backlog?
bullish.reason: AWS 宣布採購 200 萬顆 NVIDIA 高階 GPU，顯示其在 AI 基礎設施的領先布局，將顯著提升雲端運算競爭力。

bullish.title: Amazon's $100 Billion Anthropic Contract Gets a 45% Cheaper Engine
bullish.reason: Anthropic 的 Claude Fable 5.1 模型成本降低 45%，將優化 AWS 客戶的經濟效益，深化雙方合作價值。

bullish.title: Palantir Billionaire Peter Thiel Buys an AI Stock Up 560% in 10 Years (Hint: Not Nvidia)
bullish.reason: 知名投資人 Peter Thiel 在第二季買入 Amazon 股票，顯示機構投資者對其 AI 轉型與長期成長的信心。

bullish.title: Founder-Led Companies That Are Redefining Technology and Growth
bullish.reason: Amazon 被列為創辦人領導的頂尖科技公司，強調其強大的創新願景與長期成長潛力。

bullish.title: The Zacks Analyst Blog Highlights Amazon.com, AbbVie, Alibaba and Lulu's Fashion Lounge
bullish.reason: 分析師看好 Amazon 的多元化成長策略與 AI 業務推動力，維持正面評價。

bullish.title: OpenAI Declares “AGI Era” With Astra Launch. Anthropic’s Fable 5.1 More Than Doubled Its Predecessor’s Science Score. MSFT and AMZN Both Win
bullish.reason: Anthropic 模型效能大幅提升，作為主要合作夥伴的 Amazon 將從中獲益，強化其在 AI 領域的競爭優勢。

bullish.title: Better Consumer Stock for 2026: Amazon.com vs. Walt Disney
bullish.reason: 比較報告指出 Amazon 的雲端市占率與 10.8% 的淨利率優於 Disney，具備更佳的財務體質。

bullish.title: Amazon vs. Microsoft: 1 Key Metric Identifies the Superior Artificial Intelligence (AI) Cloud Stock
bullish.reason: 分析指出 Amazon 的雲端營收成長正在加速，展現出與 Microsoft 在 AI 領域競爭的強勁實力。

bearish.title: FTC's Andrew Ferguson on Amazon lawsuit: Received billions in additional profit from advertisers
bearish.reason: FTC 主席針對反壟斷訴訟發言，指控 Amazon 從廣告商獲取不當利潤，增加法律與監管風險。

bearish.title: DOJ expands beef price probe to eight retailers, including Walmart and Amazon
bearish.reason: 司法部擴大對零售商牛肉價格的調查，Amazon 被列入名單，可能面臨合規成本與聲譽損害。

bearish.title: What Amazon.com (AMZN)'s Riverside Warehouse Strike Reveals About Labor Risk in Its Logistics Model
bearish.reason: 加州倉庫發生罷工事件，凸顯 Amazon 在物流模式中面臨的勞工組織與營運中斷風險。

bearish.title: Market Chatter: Global Corporate Giants Draw Regulatory Attention to Blacklisted Groups in Supply Chains
bearish.reason: 供應鏈涉及黑名單企業引發監管關注，增加企業社會責任與合規壓力。

bearish.title: How Far Can Amazon Stock Fall When The Business Is Fine?
bearish.reason: 股價近期下跌 10%，反映市場對短期波動的擔憂，儘管基本面依然穩健。

bearish.title: Market Chatter: Anthropic, OpenAI Take Different Positions on Massachusetts AI Safety Bill
bearish.reason: Amazon 投資的 Anthropic 支持 AI 安全法案，可能對未來 AI 產品開發速度與成本產生影響。

neutral.title: Waymo and Zoox expand into more U.S. markets as robotaxi race heats up
neutral.reason: Amazon 旗下的 Zoox 擴大自動駕駛測試，屬於長期布局，對短期股價影響有限。

neutral.title: Jensen Huang's Nvidia Guided for 70% Revenue Growth in Fiscal 2028
neutral.reason: 此新聞主要聚焦於 NVIDIA 的財測，Amazon 的採購僅為背景資訊，對 AMZN 本身影響中性。

neutral.title: Understanding Amazon.com's Position In Broadline Retail Industry Compared To Competitors
neutral.reason: 行業分析報告，提供競爭格局概覽，無具體利多或利空催化劑。

neutral.title: Amazon.com (AMZN): AI Exposure Adds, But Other Businesses Drive Results
neutral.reason: 投資信件摘要，重申 AI 業務與核心業務的貢獻，屬於例行性分析。

neutral.title: Walmart Jumps Nearly 2.8% as Justice Department Widens Beef-Pricing Review
neutral.reason: 此新聞重點在於 Walmart 的股價反應，Amazon 僅被提及為受調查對象之一，影響力較小。

neutral.title: Trump's DOJ Expands Beef Price Probe to Walmart, Costco, Amazon and 5 Other Retail Giants
neutral.reason: 與上述 DOJ 調查重複，選此篇作為代表，強調調查範圍廣泛，對單一公司影響尚不明確。
